next.reason: 2023 repeats the 1985 rule word for word: 'The NO REWIND phrase will be ignored if it does not apply to the storage medium on which the file resides' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR11). Its status '07' sentence restates §2023:9.1.13.2 GR6, which 1985's I-O status 07 already gave for 'an OPEN statement with the NO REWIND phrase' on a non-reel/unit medium. Same effect.
